decision: done means: on this laptop a session blocks sleep and lid suspend, a closed lid mutes and holds power-saver, opening or ending restores both, and a killed daemon restores on restart

decision: start with no duration, and the prompt's empty submit, ended the session at once; zero now means the default preset

decision: a closed lid with every output already muted ran pactl 3 times a second for the whole close; now a close mutes once and an absent sink's restore retries every 30 s
why: it wasted battery in exactly the mode meant to save it
evidence: probe counted 30 calls in 10 s; e2e check 'a closed lid does not keep calling pactl' fails on the old daemon

decision: an inline zsh probe muted the real HDMI output and its bash-only cleanup failed; unmuted it by hand

decision: a docked lid close (external display attached) no longer mutes or holds power-saver; it only turns the panel off

evidence: busctl LidClosed/Docked probe; Lid::ClosedDocked in linux/src/model.rs; e2e 'a docked close leaves the audio alone'

decision: added turning the panel off on lid close, journaled, restored on open, end, SIGTERM and restart; a level set by hand during the close is kept

decision: mute and darkening share one Reversible state type: apply once per close, undo when the plan drops it, retry the undo every 30 s while journaled
